1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable to provide access to internal components of the cooling system__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

3. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and wherein the water distributor includes a plurality of distribution channels__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, __and wherein the motor drives the fan to create forced air circulation__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __that includes a ventilation grill positioned on an interior wall surface__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation __through a return channel integrated within the housing__.

8. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable to provide access to internal components of the cooling system__.

12. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __constructed with wooden frame studs__.

14. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __including screws for attachment to wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing for mounting within a structure wall between wall studs__, __an evaporative cooling assembly positioned within the housing for evaporatively cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is mounted__ between wall studs spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

19. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing__ protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
